stem: Watson and Crick proposed which structural description of DNA?

options.label: A
options.text: A hollow tube made of membrane lipids
options.misconception: Membrane fantasy — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Irrelevant; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: B
options.text: Two strands twisted into a helix
options.misconception: None; DNA is a double helix.
options.explanation: OpenStax recounts two strands twisted around each other.

options.label: C
options.text: One peptide strand in an alpha coil
options.explanation: DNA is nucleic acid; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.misconception: Wrong polymer class — does not match the cited teaching point.

context: Learning objective: DNA is a double helix.
